methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched and verified directly via WebFetch for accessiBe (accessibe.com/pricing/accesswidget), UserWay (userway.org/pricing/), Equally AI (equally.ai/pricing), and AccessibilityChecker.org (accessibilitychecker.org/pricing/) — all published dollar amounts matched the draft exactly. AudioEye's official plans page (audioeye.com/plans-and-pricing/) publishes NO dollar amounts (Basic=Start Free Trial, Self-Serviced/Maximum=Schedule Demo); AudioEye is therefore listed quote-only with monthlyUsd=null. Third-party $199/$399/$799/mo estimates were rejected as unverified and excluded. AudioEye HIPAA + SOC 2 Type II verified via the official press release (audioeye.com/post/, 2024-09-26), replacing the third-party martechedge citation. Equally AI's acquisition by AudioEye verified on equally.ai/about ('an AudioEye company'). Silktide, Level Access, and UsableNet confirmed quote-only via their own sites (no published prices). accessiBe prices are annual-billing equivalents; per-plan notes carry the annual figure. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: accessiBe
vendors.provenance: Pricing verified from accessibe.com/pricing/accesswidget (2026-06-18); plans billed annually (~30% cheaper than monthly), monthly figures are annual-billing equivalents. SOC 2 confirmed on accessibe.com/security. 7-day free trial (no credit card) confirmed.

plans.name: Micro
plans.notes: Up to 5,000 visits/month per domain. Annual billing only at $490/year (~$41/mo equivalent). Automated 24-hour scans, accessibility widget, 33-language support, basic support.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Up to 30,000 visits/month per domain. Annual billing at $1,490/year (~$124/mo equivalent). Adds dedicated litigation support case manager, Google Analytics integration, team management.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Up to 100,000 visits/month per domain. Annual billing at $3,990/year (~$333/mo equivalent). Adds yearly expert manual testing, custom remediation fixes, ADA attorney consultation (1 hour).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Above 100,000 visits/month. Custom pricing, contact sales. Includes SSO, solution engineering, dedicated account manager, on-demand expert testing, 5 hours ADA attorney consultation.

limits: Traffic-based tiers: Micro ≤5K visits/mo, Growth ≤30K, Scale ≤100K
Subdomains require separate subscriptions
Annual-only billing for published plans
keyFeatures: AI-powered automated WCAG 2.1 AA remediation every 24 hours
Built-in litigation support with dedicated case manager (Growth+)
Annual manual expert testing (Scale+)
ADA attorney consultation included
enrichment.provenance: Pricing verified from official accessibe.com/pricing/accesswidget (2026-06-18); all four plan prices matched draft. SOC 2 verified from accessibe.com/security. 7-day free trial confirmed.
